canada.title: Crews work to contain fire at Halifax Grain Elevator
canada.summary: Halifax Regional Fire and Emergency says 56 firefighters and 20 apparatus were at the scene. The fire was reported shortly after 7 p.m. on Monday.

canada.title: Supporters rally as historic youth-led climate trial begins in Vancouver
canada.summary: Crowds of supporters gathered outside the Federal Court building in Vancouver on Monday in solidarity with plaintiffs in Canada's first youth-led climate trial.

canada.title: ‘Second-hand fashion at its best’: Inside the first thrift store fashion show in Dawson City
canada.summary: The town’s thrift store held its first-ever fashion show in its more than 40-years of history to raise funds for the community.

canada.title: Sask. First Nations leaders raise land rights, policing concerns at historic Ottawa meeting
canada.summary: Federal government heard reasoning behind amending Indian status legislation and setting up First Nations policing from Saskatchewan chiefs.

canada.title: Winnipegger raises money for CancerCare Manitoba with giant jack-o’-lanterns
canada.summary: Chris Okell carves out heavyweight pumpkins in honour of his mom who loved Halloween — a promise he's upheld every year while trying to raise money for cancer.

canada.title: Employees shaken after car dealership among several targeted in month-long string of break-ins, thefts
canada.summary: A 35-year-old man has been charged with stealing several vehicles from across Winnipeg, including many from dealerships and autobody shops.

canada.title: Outspoken UCP MLA Shane Getson leaving Alberta’s legislature
canada.summary: A plainspoken, two-term United Conservative backbencher who has at times courted controversy and riled up the Opposition NDP is resigning his seat in Alberta’s legislature.

canada.title: 'Time to abolish the Indian Act,' Manitoba premier tells PM in historic meeting with chiefs
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew is calling on the federal government to abolish the Indian Act, in a move that saw a warm reception from some but drew criticism elsewhere.

canada.title: 8-year-old girl, woman taken to hospital after collision in North York
canada.summary: An adult and child have been rushed to the hospital following a collision in North York, police say.

canada.title: First Nation of Na-Cho Nyäk Dun says it’s up to citizens to decide how to move forward on Eagle mine
canada.summary: The First Nation at the centre of the Eagle gold mine disaster in north-central Yukon says it will ultimately be up to its citizens to decide how it plans to support the sale of the mine to a foreign mining company.

canada.title: New research involving Nunavut fossil raises question over the origin of necks
canada.summary: A new study involving a 380-million-year-old fossil from Nunavut is sparking new questions amongst researchers as to why tetrapods originally developed necks.

canada.title: Youth go to court to make Canada legally accountable for its role climate crisis
canada.summary: The first youth-led climate trial in Canadian history has begun at the federal courthouse in downtown Vancouver, where 15 plaintiffs are arguing that federal legislation violates their constitutional rights by continuing the trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions.

canada.title: Montreal police seek help locating missing 72-year-old woman who could be disoriented
canada.summary: Montreal police are seeking the public's help to locate Leonne Aneus, a 72-year-old woman missing since Saturday afternoon.

canada.title: Trial for Sundre woman accused of sexually assaulting teenager begins
canada.summary: A two-week trial got underway Monday for Alexa Suitor, who is accused of sexually assaulting a 15-year-old boy.

canada.title: Carney open to conversations around ‘moving beyond’ the Indian Act
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday that he's opening to 'moving beyond' or abolishing the Indian Act.

canada.title: Moncton council asks for short-term rental rules
canada.summary: Moncton councillors have asked city staff to draft a bylaw regulating short-term rentals like Airbnb and Vrbo.

canada.title: Uniqlo to move into old Nordstrom building in downtown Vancouver
canada.summary: Since Nordstrom closed, many have speculated as to what storefront could fill the space and last year it was announced that it would be divided into four units.

canada.title: Montreal police officer who allegedly urinated on homeless people faces ethics probe
canada.summary: Guy Lapointe Jr., Quebec's new domestic security, said both the police ethics commissioner and the province's independent police watchdog, known as the BEI, will look into the allegations.
